name: f1-dev-tools
description: Inspect, profile, debug and validate Apex 26 UI, memory, rendering, garage parts, cameras and replay using the game checkout’s developer tools.

interface.longDescription: Project-specific workflows for brycejmurrin/f1-game: semantic UI inspection, CPU and memory diagnostics, graphics profiling, garage angles and parts, JavaScript debugging, scene reproduction, camera comparison, WATCH replay checks, and preset preview/export. Uses the repository MCP servers and preserves page diagnosis, release-asset checks and storage reporting.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the configured apex-tools MCP for game identity and diagnostics, then one browser MCP at a time: playwright-official for navigation/DOM/screenshots or chrome-devtools for live console/network/performance inspection. For source debugging, use js-debugger on the parent's existing local Chrome page; inspect fresh pause tokens and detach afterward. Reproduce and inspect the f1-game camera or replay problem, then validate the change with matching render traces.
